Although memory costs are expected to easily become the single largest line item on the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here's the detail.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Display Deal With Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple and Samsung Display have signed an exclusive three-year supply deal for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its subsequent models," at a cost of about $250 per panel.

The leaker also noted that the panel is, unsurprisingly, "one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

While there's no credible report yet detailing the iPhone Duo's expected bill of materials, Apple has shared some interesting information about its materials content — including how much of it is recycled — broken down by the cost contribution of display, camera, processor, memory and other components.

As for the actual bill of materials for the device, teardowns and other analyses once it goes on sale next month should give us a much clearer picture.
